requirements.quote: `packages/db/src/schema/corpus.ts` and a migration: a global `judgment_segment` table (ADR 0050 §Segments).
`search_tsv`: generated `setweight(to_tsvector('english', text),'A') || to_tsvector('simple', text)`, with a GIN index.
Range-partitioned by `judgment_year` in decades, with hand-written partition SQL in the migration and a default partition.
Add it to the root table list in `packages/db/src/index.test.ts` (global, no RLS; the app role has SELECT only).
Split into paragraphs, using the court's numbered paragraphs where present.
Classify each paragraph's rhetorical role: rules plus a classifier, and the AI gateway below a confidence threshold.
Pack 300–600-token segments that never cross a role boundary, keeping page anchors.
`apps/worker`: a `corpus.segment` job chained after redaction, which also backfills existing rows. Register it in the worker registry tests.
Every judgment in the pinned sample produces segments whose concatenated text equals its redacted text (no loss), with valid page anchors. [type:unit]
Role accuracy on a labelled set of at least 20 judgments: macro-F1 of at least 0.75, reported. [type:integration]
`websearch_to_tsquery('english', '"res ipsa loquitur"')` and a section query (`304A`) return the expected segments from fixtures. [type:integration]
An `EXPLAIN` of a year-filtered query shows partition pruning. [type:integration]
The migration declares lz4 compression on the large text columns. [type:unit]

deliverables.change: Export CORPUS_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS (=EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS, 1024) and a halfvecEmbedding() helper using drizzle halfvec.

Add judgmentSegment table (columns, role CHECK, generated search_tsv via custom tsvector type, GIN index, unique (judgment_id, ordinal, judgment_year)), JUDGMENT_SEGMENT_ROLES, and judgment.segment_version integer default 0.

drizzle-generated then hand-edited: partitioned judgment_segment (decade partitions + DEFAULT), GIN index, SET COMPRESSION lz4 on judgment_segment.text, judgment.page_text, judgment.redacted_text; GRANT SELECT (and the INSERT/DELETE the segment job needs) plus UPDATE(segment_version) on judgment; use next free number if taken.
Regenerated snapshot and journal entry for the migration (plus meta/_journal.json if present).
Add judgment_segment to the root table list.

Migration text test (lz4 on segment text and judgment.page_text, partition + default) and testcontainers integration: FTS queries for 'res ipsa loquitur' and '304A', EXPLAIN of year-filtered query prunes partitions.

Pure segmenter: paragraph split with numbered paragraphs, rule-based role classifier with confidence, injectable zod-validated low-confidence resolver port, 300-600 token packer that never crosses a role, page anchors, SEGMENT_VERSION.
Unit tests: no-loss concatenation over the pinned fixture sample with valid page anchors; role boundary and size packing; resolver failure fallback.

Macro-F1 evaluation over >=20 labelled judgments (fixtures committed alongside, e.g. segment-fixtures.ts) asserting >=0.75; commit the report as packages/intelligence/src/corpus/SEGMENT-EVALUATION.md.

system.corpus.segment job: batch-select judgments with redacted_text and segment_version/redaction mismatch, replace their segments in a transaction from redactedText only, set segment_version; scheduled so it follows redaction and backfills.
Job test: backfill, re-segment after redaction bump, idempotent rerun, reads redacted_text not page_text.
Register corpusSegment in the job list and type tuple.
Add the corpus.segment schedule if the job defines one (match corpus.ocr).
Add 'system.corpus.segment' to the expected job names.
Add the segment schedule to the expected list.
NOT_A_SERVICE entries (reason: global corpus job/schema, no tenant data) for new @causedeck/core runtime exports corpusSegment, corpusSegmentSchema, runCorpusSegment, CORPUS_SEGMENT_BATCH.

preserve.what: judgment.page_text and sha256 stay immutable for the app role; only derived columns are updatable (packages/db/migrations/20261030181659_corpus_redaction.sql grants).
packages/core/src/__tests__/page-text-access.test.ts: the segment job and segment code read redacted_text, never judgment.pageText.
corpus.redact job behaviour (packages/core/src/jobs/definitions/corpus-redact.ts) and REDACTION_VERSION semantics are unchanged.
judgment.embedding column and its HNSW index (packages/db/src/schema/corpus.ts:77,89) stay; dropping is a later contract migration.
Existing migrations and their snapshots are not edited; new migration uses the next free number.

decisions.choice: Chain via a self-selecting scheduled job keyed on a new judgment.segment_version plus redaction_version, instead of enqueueing from corpus.redact.
decisions.justification: JobContext has no enqueue API (packages/core/src/jobs/context.ts); corpus-redact.ts:28-86 has no downstream hook; corpus.ocr is the schedule precedent (apps/worker/src/__tests__/schedules.test.ts:47).

decisions.choice: Segment text is built from judgment.redacted_text only.
decisions.justification: ADR 0051 §Anonymised text; page-text-access.test.ts forbids raw readers outside the allow-list.

decisions.choice: Hand-write partitioned DDL (decade ranges + DEFAULT) with PK including judgment_year; drizzle does not model partitions.
decisions.justification: ADR 0051 §Segments: 'hand-written SQL in the migration, because drizzle does not model partitions'.

decisions.choice: Add judgment_segment to GLOBAL_TABLES (no RLS, app role SELECT-only plus the job's write grants).
decisions.justification: packages/db/src/conventions.ts:79-83 lists every global corpus table; ADR 0051 'global tables need no RLS'.

decisions.choice: No new workspace package dependencies; the low-confidence resolver is a port like redact/gateway.ts so intelligence imports no gateway.
